content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Daniel Gutierrez (E046) requests write access to Payroll.

There are two notes:
- Note 1 (from HR): role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time, recommendation write.
- Note 2 (from Security): employment type contractor, security training basic, role Payroll Specialist, recommendation read.

The Security note says security record governs - contractor with basic training. Contractors max out at read without advanced training. So write is not permitted; recommend read.

The policy: contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Per policy, contractor with basic training maxes at read. So the maximum is read. Requested write is above max, so grant max = read.

So decision: read.

Evidence: Security record shows contractor with basic training; contractor without advanced training maxes at read, so grant read.
